title: 海水淡化鹵水擴散排放
summary: 本課逐步拆解膜段鹽量、背景稀釋、孔口流速、密度差、噴流動量與海域交換，建立可檢核的鹵水擴散分析鏈。近場、遠場和長期箱體各有控制體與適用邊界，必須分別驗證後才銜接；全部算例為原創假設，並非實廠排放或許可限值。
summaryEn: This course develops a checkable brine-analysis chain through membrane salt balance, background dilution, port velocity, density contrast, jet momentum and receiving-basin exchange. Near-field, far-field and long-term box models have distinct control volumes and validity limits that require separate verification before coupling. All calculations use original assumptions, not plant discharge measurements or permit limits.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 敏感度算例固定單孔流量q=0.050 m³/s及縮減重力g′=0.15 m/s²，只將孔徑由0.20 m增加至0.22 m。面平均噴速由1.5915降至1.3153 m/s，降低17.36%；密度福祿數由9.1888降至7.2407，降低21.20%，因固定流量時速度隨孔徑平方反比而變，福祿數隨孔徑的二點五次方反比。這只比較初始尺度，沒有把福祿數當成稀釋倍數，也沒有預測海床接觸點。實際比較還需幹管壓力、角度、潮流和多孔交互作用，不能只依孔徑變大就宣稱環境改善。
workedExample.textEn: For sensitivity, hold one-port flow q=0.050 m³/s and reduced gravity g′=0.15 m/s² fixed while increasing diameter from 0.20 to 0.22 m. Mean exit velocity falls from 1.5915 to 1.3153 m/s, a 17.36% reduction. Densimetric Froude number falls from 9.1888 to 7.2407, a 21.20% reduction: velocity varies as diameter to the power −2 and Froude number as diameter to the power −2.5 at fixed flow. These are initial-scale comparisons, not dilution predictions or seabed-contact locations. Header pressure, discharge angle, tidal currents, seabed clearance and multiport interaction remain necessary before judging environmental performance. The calculation does not establish an ecological threshold or discharge approval.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「濃縮鹽量守恆機理與驗證」與「背景鹽度與稀釋定義機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Concentrate salt conservation mechanism and verification" and "Background salinity and dilution mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 濃縮鹽量守恆機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Concentrate salt conservation mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「濃縮鹽量守恆」如何影響海水淡化鹵水擴散排放的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Concentrate salt conservation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Brine diffuser outfalls for desalination”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 淡化膜將進流水分配成產品與濃水，鹽分不會因水量減少而消失。若用質量鹽度表示濃度，必須同時使用質量流率，並保留產品水殘餘鹽分；以體積流量近似時則須明說密度差的處理。濃水濃度不只決定排口鹽負荷，也會改變密度、浮力與混合路徑，不能把產水效率與海域影響分開看待。本例固定進水質量流率並假設產品完全不含鹽，只作理想守恆；真實產品鹽分、藥劑與其他支流需要另外計入。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「濃縮鹽量守恆」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A membrane separates feed into product and concentrate without making dissolved salt disappear. Mass-based salinity requires mass flow rates and retention of residual product salt. A volume-flow approximation must state how density differences are treated. Concentrate salinity affects salt loading, density, buoyancy and mixing trajectory, linking recovery decisions to the receiving environment. This ideal balance fixes feed mass flow and assumes salt-free product. Actual product salt, chemical additions and side streams require separate accounting. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Concentrate salt conservation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設進水mf=1000 kg/s、產品mp=400 kg/s、進水鹽度Sf=35 g/kg且Sp=0，mb=600 kg/s，Sb=mfSf/mb=58.33 g/kg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume feed mf=1000 kg/s, product mp=400 kg/s, feed Sf=35 g/kg and product Sp=0.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「提高產水回收率會讓剩下濃水中的總鹽量自行消失。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher water recovery makes the remaining concentrate salt disappear." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「濃縮鹽量守恆」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Concentrate salt conservation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 濃縮鹽量守恆機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Concentrate salt conservation mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 淡化膜將進流水分配成產品與濃水，鹽分不會因水量減少而消失。若用質量鹽度表示濃度，必須同時使用質量流率，並保留產品水殘餘鹽分；以體積流量近似時則須明說密度差的處理。
knowledge.textEn: A membrane separates feed into product and concentrate without making dissolved salt disappear. Mass-based salinity requires mass flow rates and retention of residual product salt.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：提高產水回收率會讓剩下濃水中的總鹽量自行消失。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher water recovery makes the remaining concentrate salt disappear. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「濃縮鹽量守恆機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Concentrate salt conservation mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 提高產水回收率會讓剩下濃水中的總鹽量自行消失。
淡化膜將進流水分配成產品與濃水，鹽分不會因水量減少而消失。
海水鹵水稀釋十倍就是把原始總鹽度直接除以十。
optionsEn: Higher water recovery makes the remaining concentrate salt disappear.
A membrane separates feed into product and concentrate without making dissolved salt disappear.
Tenfold seawater-brine dilution means dividing total original salinity by ten.
quiz.explanation: 淡化膜將進流水分配成產品與濃水，鹽分不會因水量減少而消失。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A membrane separates feed into product and concentrate without making dissolved salt disappear. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 濃縮鹽量守恆機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Concentrate salt conservation mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「濃縮鹽量守恆」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Concentrate salt conservation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設進水mf=1000 kg/s、產品mp=400 kg/s、進水鹽度Sf=35 g/kg且Sp=0，mb=600 kg/s，Sb=mfSf/mb=58.33 g/kg。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume feed mf=1000 kg/s, product mp=400 kg/s, feed Sf=35 g/kg and product Sp=0. Concentrate mb=600 kg/s and Sb=mfSf/mb=58.33 g/kg. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將各股流的流率、密度與鹽度同步量測，統一為質量鹽通量後檢查收支。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure stream flow, density and salinity synchronously, convert them to salt mass flux and check closure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume feed mf=1000 kg/s, product mp=400 kg/s, feed Sf=35 g/kg and product Sp=0. Concentrate mb=600 kg/s and Sb=mfSf/mb=58.33 g/kg.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「濃縮鹽量守恆機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Concentrate salt conservation mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 只要鹽度較高，就可忽略溫度並沿用所有上浮羽流公式。
流量乘速度已經是牛頓力，而且所有噴口反力只須加大小。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設進水mf=1000 kg/s、產品mp=400 kg/s、進水鹽度Sf=35 g/kg且Sp=0，mb=600 kg/s，Sb=mfSf/mb=58.33 g/kg。
optionsEn: Higher salinity allows temperature to be ignored and all rising-plume formulas reused.
Flow times velocity is already force in newtons and port reactions require only scalar addition.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume feed mf=1000 kg/s, product mp=400 kg/s, feed Sf=35 g/kg and product Sp=0.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設進水mf=1000 kg/s、產品mp=400 kg/s、進水鹽度Sf=35 g/kg且Sp=0，mb=600 kg/s，Sb=mfSf/mb=58.33 g/kg。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume feed mf=1000 kg/s, product mp=400 kg/s, feed Sf=35 g/kg and product Sp=0. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 濃縮鹽量守恆機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Concentrate salt conservation mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「濃縮鹽量守恆」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Concentrate salt conservation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將各股流的流率、密度與鹽度同步量測，統一為質量鹽通量後檢查收支。保留儀表校正與預處理支流資料，確認未把不同時間的最大流量與最高鹽度拼成不存在的工況。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure stream flow, density and salinity synchronously, convert them to salt mass flux and check closure. Retain calibration and pretreatment-stream records, ensuring that maxima from different times are not combined into a physically nonexistent operating state. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出三股質量流及鹽通量，先用理想零產品鹽度求解，再加入假設殘餘鹽分。說明哪些流量計資料必須搭配密度才能維持相同守恆基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw the three mass and salt flows, solve first with salt-free product, then introduce residual product salinity. Explain which flow-meter data require density to maintain a consistent conservation basis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用質量鹽度直接乘不一致的體積流率會引入密度誤差，忽略產品與排泥鹽分則使收支失真；錯誤的濃度輸入還會傳到負浮力羽流模型。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Multiplying mass salinity by inconsistent volume flow introduces density error, while omitted product or sludge salt distorts closure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 將各股流的流率、密度與鹽度同步量測，統一為質量鹽通量後檢查收支。保留儀表校正與預處理支流資料，確認未把不同時間的最大流量與最高鹽度拼成不存在的工況。
knowledge.textEn: Measure stream flow, density and salinity synchronously, convert them to salt mass flux and check closure. Retain calibration and pretreatment-stream records, ensuring that maxima from different times are not combined into a physically nonexistent operating state.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 畫出三股質量流及鹽通量，先用理想零產品鹽度求解，再加入假設殘餘鹽分。說明哪些流量計資料必須搭配密度才能維持相同守恆基準。
knowledge.textEn: Draw the three mass and salt flows, solve first with salt-free product, then introduce residual product salinity. Explain which flow-meter data require density to maintain a consistent conservation basis.

quiz.question: 要驗證「濃縮鹽量守恆機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Concentrate salt conservation mechanism and verification"?
options: 將各股流的流率、密度與鹽度同步量測，統一為質量鹽通量後檢查收支。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
海流速度乘一小時得到的距離，就是鹵水必然被稀釋完的位置。
optionsEn: Measure stream flow, density and salinity synchronously, convert them to salt mass flux and check closure.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Current speed times one hour gives the distance at which brine is necessarily fully diluted.
quiz.explanation: 將各股流的流率、密度與鹽度同步量測，統一為質量鹽通量後檢查收支。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure stream flow, density and salinity synchronously, convert them to salt mass flux and check closure. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 濃縮鹽量守恆機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Concentrate salt conservation mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「濃縮鹽量守恆」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Concentrate salt conservation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用質量鹽度直接乘不一致的體積流率會引入密度誤差，忽略產品與排泥鹽分則使收支失真；錯誤的濃度輸入還會傳到負浮力羽流模型。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Multiplying mass salinity by inconsistent volume flow introduces density error, while omitted product or sludge salt distorts closure. Incorrect concentrate inputs then propagate into the negatively buoyant plume model. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例固定進水質量流率並假設產品完全不含鹽，只作理想守恆；真實產品鹽分、藥劑與其他支流需要另外計入。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Actual product salt, chemical additions and side streams require separate accounting.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「提高產水回收率會讓剩下濃水中的總鹽量自行消失。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher water recovery makes the remaining concentrate salt disappear." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用質量鹽度直接乘不一致的體積流率會引入密度誤差，忽略產品與排泥鹽分則使收支失真；錯誤的濃度輸入還會傳到負浮力羽流模型。
knowledge.textEn: Multiplying mass salinity by inconsistent volume flow introduces density error, while omitted product or sludge salt distorts closure. Incorrect concentrate inputs then propagate into the negatively buoyant plume model.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

steps.instruction: 鹵水通常比受納海水密度大，其浮力方向與較淡的污水羽流不同。密度差受鹽度和溫度共同影響，應在相同壓力基準下比較；縮減重力把密度差轉為浮力尺度，但並不單獨決定上升高度、落點或海床濃度，這些仍取決於噴射動量與環境流場。本例採環境密度作分母，計算負浮力的大小；若座標向上為正，對較重排放的有號浮力加速度應另記為負值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「密度差與縮減重力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Salinity and temperature jointly affect density and must be compared at a consistent pressure basis. Reduced gravity expresses the density contrast as a buoyancy scale, but jet momentum and ambient flow are still needed to predict rise, return or seabed concentration. Ambient density is the reference denominator and the calculation gives negative-buoyancy magnitude. With upward positive, the signed buoyancy acceleration for denser discharge is negative. knowledge.title: 密度差與縮減重力機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Density contrast and reduced gravity mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 鹵水通常比受納海水密度大，其浮力方向與較淡的污水羽流不同。密度差受鹽度和溫度共同影響，應在相同壓力基準下比較；縮減重力把密度差轉為浮力尺度，但並不單獨決定上升高度、落點或海床濃度，這些仍取決於噴射動量與環境流場。
knowledge.textEn: Brine is commonly denser than receiving seawater, giving it the opposite buoyancy direction to a fresher wastewater plume. Salinity and temperature jointly affect density and must be compared at a consistent pressure basis.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要鹽度較高，就可忽略溫度並沿用所有上浮羽流公式。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher salinity allows temperature to be ignored and all rising-plume formulas reused. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「密度差與縮減重力機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Density contrast and reduced gravity mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 只要鹽度較高，就可忽略溫度並沿用所有上浮羽流公式。
鹵水通常比受納海水密度大，其浮力方向與較淡的污水羽流不同。
密度福祿數等於最後稀釋倍數，而且越大就一定越環保。
optionsEn: Higher salinity allows temperature to be ignored and all rising-plume formulas reused.
Brine is commonly denser than receiving seawater, giving it the opposite buoyancy direction to a fresher wastewater plume.
Densimetric Froude number equals final dilution and a larger value always means less impact.
quiz.explanation: 鹵水通常比受納海水密度大，其浮力方向與較淡的污水羽流不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Brine is commonly denser than receiving seawater, giving it the opposite buoyancy direction to a fresher wastewater plume. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「密度差與縮減重力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume discharge ρb=1040 kg/m³, ambient ρa=1025 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Reduced-gravity magnitude g′=g(ρb−ρa)/ρa=0.1436 m/s². Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

Check model sign conventions and reference density, and test the zero-density-difference limit to confirm that the buoyancy term vanishes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：把負浮力套入只適合上浮羽流的終止或遠場假設，可能漏掉海床接觸與沿底擴散；忽略溫度差也可能誤估密度差大小甚至方向。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying rising-plume termination or far-field assumptions to negative buoyancy can omit seabed contact and bottom spreading. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 密度福祿數機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Densimetric Froude number mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「密度福祿數」如何影響海水淡化鹵水擴散排放的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Densimetric Froude number” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Brine diffuser outfalls for desalination”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 密度福祿數比較噴口慣性與密度差浮力，以孔徑、噴射速度及縮減重力構成無量綱比例。較大的比例代表初始動量相對較強，卻不保證所有位置的稀釋更好；出口角度、海床距離、相鄰噴流與環境流向都會改變後續軌跡，必須在相似條件下比較。本例使用單孔圓射流的尺度定義，沒有套入未驗證的經驗稀釋係數；無量綱值不能直接當成稀釋倍數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「密度福祿數」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The densimetric Froude number compares port inertia with density-driven buoyancy using diameter, velocity and reduced gravity. A larger ratio indicates stronger initial momentum relative to buoyancy but does not guarantee better dilution everywhere. Discharge angle, bed clearance, neighboring jets and ambient-current direction alter the subsequent trajectory, so comparisons require compatible conditions. The example uses the scale definition for one circular jet without an unverified empirical dilution coefficient. This dimensionless value is not itself a dilution factor. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Densimetric Froude number” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設噴速v=3.0 m/s、g′=0.15 m/s²、孔徑d=0.20 m，Fd=v/√(g′d)=17.32。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume jet speed v=3.0 m/s, g′=0.15 m/s² and diameter d=0.20 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「密度福祿數等於最後稀釋倍數，而且越大就一定越環保。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Densimetric Froude number equals final dilution and a larger value always means less impact." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「密度福祿數」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

Compare inputs with the validated parameter range of the experiment or model, and independently verify seabed contact location and peak concentration before interpreting performance. steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ambient currents and residence scales” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Brine diffuser outfalls for desalination”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 離開初始動量主導區後，羽流會受到海流、潮汐反轉及紊動輸送影響。以流速乘時間只能估計被動水團的平移尺度，不能描述密度流沿底滑動或回流累積；弱流時平均流向也可能不穩定，單一順流斷面可能漏掉往返經過的高鹽水。本例假設速度均勻且方向不變，忽略擴散、剪切及重力流；平移距離不是混合區邊界或鹽度達標距離。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「環境流與停留尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Beyond the initial momentum-dominated region, currents, tidal reversal and turbulence influence transport. Velocity times time estimates passive water-parcel translation but does not describe bottom density currents or recirculating accumulation. Under weak flow the mean direction may be unstable, and one downstream transect can miss concentrated water returning with the tide. The example assumes uniform constant-direction velocity, excluding dispersion, shear and gravity currents. Translation distance is neither a mixing-zone boundary nor a distance to a salinity target. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ambient currents and residence scales” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.textEn: Compare one-way transport with a current reversing after half an hour, explaining why equal speed does not imply equal displacement or exposure history. Identify cases requiring three-dimensional hydrodynamics coupled to density.

quiz.question: 要驗證「環境流與停留尺度機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ambient currents and residence scales mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
使用涵蓋潮週期的流速剖面和溫鹽量測，區分平均流、剪切與短時反轉。
密度福祿數等於最後稀釋倍數，而且越大就一定越環保。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Use velocity profiles and temperature-salinity measurements spanning tidal cycles to distinguish mean transport, shear and short reversals.
Densimetric Froude number equals final dilution and a larger value always means less impact.
quiz.explanation: 使用涵蓋潮週期的流速剖面和溫鹽量測，區分平均流、剪切與短時反轉。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use velocity profiles and temperature-salinity measurements spanning tidal cycles to distinguish mean transport, shear and short reversals. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 環境流與停留尺度機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ambient currents and residence scales mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「環境流與停留尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ambient currents and residence scales” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用最大順流速度會低估弱流期停留與累積，直接把上浮羽流的被動遠場模組接到沿底重流也可能違反模型假設，造成系統性低估暴露。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using only maximum favorable current understates residence and accumulation during weak flow. Connecting a passive far-field module for rising plumes directly to bottom gravity flow can violate assumptions and systematically understate exposure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例假設速度均勻且方向不變，忽略擴散、剪切及重力流；平移距離不是混合區邊界或鹽度達標距離。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Translation distance is neither a mixing-zone boundary nor a distance to a salinity target.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「海流速度乘一小時得到的距離，就是鹵水必然被稀釋完的位置。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Current speed times one hour gives the distance at which brine is necessarily fully diluted." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「環境流與停留尺度機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ambient currents and residence scales mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
排口附近混合很快，所以半封閉海灣的長期鹽量帳不必計算。
只用最大順流速度會低估弱流期停留與累積，直接把上浮羽流的被動遠場模組接到沿底重流也可能違反模型假設，造成系統性低估暴露。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Rapid mixing near the outlet makes a long-term salt budget unnecessary in a semi-enclosed bay.
Using only maximum favorable current understates residence and accumulation during weak flow.
quiz.explanation: 只用最大順流速度會低估弱流期停留與累積，直接把上浮羽流的被動遠場模組接到沿底重流也可能違反模型假設，造成系統性低估暴露。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using only maximum favorable current understates residence and accumulation during weak flow. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「海域箱體鹽度收支機理與驗證」與「監測誤差與暴露判讀機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Receiving-basin salinity budget mechanism and verification" and "Monitoring uncertainty and exposure mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 海域箱體鹽度收支機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Receiving-basin salinity budget mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「海域箱體鹽度收支」如何影響海水淡化鹵水擴散排放的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Receiving-basin salinity budget” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Brine diffuser outfalls for desalination”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 近場高稀釋不代表半封閉水域不會長期累積鹽分，外海交換、潮汐回流與排放持續時間共同控制背景變化。簡化箱體可以檢查鹽量與交換流的尺度，卻把空間分層和局部高濃度平均掉；因此它適合守恆檢查，不適合取代底棲暴露或敏感區域的空間預測。本例以質量流率表示交換，箱體均勻且穩態，出流等於環境入流加排放；這不是忽略排放增量的近似交換式。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「海域箱體鹽度收支」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Strong near-field dilution does not prevent long-term salt accumulation in a semi-enclosed basin. Exchange with offshore water, tidal return and discharge duration control background change. A simple box checks salt and exchange scales but averages away stratification and local peaks, making it useful for conservation checks rather than spatial prediction of benthic exposure. The example uses mass flow, a uniform steady box, and outflow equal to ambient inflow plus discharge. It does not omit the additional discharged mass from the outlet balance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Receiving-basin salinity budget” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設外海入流Ma=9000 kg/s、Sa=35 g/kg，排放Mb=1000 kg/s、Sb=60 g/kg，穩態S=(MaSa+MbSb)/(Ma+Mb)=37.5 g/kg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume ambient inflow Ma=9000 kg/s, Sa=35 g/kg, discharge Mb=1000 kg/s and Sb=60 g/kg.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「排口附近混合很快，所以半封閉海灣的長期鹽量帳不必計算。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rapid mixing near the outlet makes a long-term salt budget unnecessary in a semi-enclosed bay." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「海域箱體鹽度收支」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Receiving-basin salinity budget”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「海域箱體鹽度收支機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Receiving-basin salinity budget mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 近場高稀釋不代表半封閉水域不會長期累積鹽分，外海交換、潮汐回流與排放持續時間共同控制背景變化。
排口附近混合很快，所以半封閉海灣的長期鹽量帳不必計算。
感測器讀值差很小，就能直接證明長期海域生態完全安全。
optionsEn: Strong near-field dilution does not prevent long-term salt accumulation in a semi-enclosed basin.

A small sensor difference directly proves complete long-term ecological safety.

quiz.explanationEn: Strong near-field dilution does not prevent long-term salt accumulation in a semi-enclosed basin. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 海域箱體鹽度收支機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Receiving-basin salinity budget mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「海域箱體鹽度收支」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Receiving-basin salinity budget” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設外海入流Ma=9000 kg/s、Sa=35 g/kg，排放Mb=1000 kg/s、Sb=60 g/kg，穩態S=(MaSa+MbSb)/(Ma+Mb)=37.5 g/kg。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume ambient inflow Ma=9000 kg/s, Sa=35 g/kg, discharge Mb=1000 kg/s and Sb=60 g/kg. Steady box S=(MaSa+MbSb)/(Ma+Mb)=37.5 g/kg. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先核對箱體水量與鹽量收支，確認外海交換不是重複計入同一來回潮水。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check both water and salt balances, ensuring that offshore exchange does not count the same returning tidal water twice.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設外海入流Ma=9000 kg/s、Sa=35 g/kg，排放Mb=1000 kg/s、Sb=60 g/kg，穩態S=(MaSa+MbSb)/(Ma+Mb)=37.5 g/kg。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume ambient inflow Ma=9000 kg/s, Sa=35 g/kg, discharge Mb=1000 kg/s and Sb=60 g/kg. Steady box S=(MaSa+MbSb)/(Ma+Mb)=37.5 g/kg.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「海域箱體鹽度收支機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Receiving-basin salinity budget mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 海水鹵水稀釋十倍就是把原始總鹽度直接除以十。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設外海入流Ma=9000 kg/s、Sa=35 g/kg，排放Mb=1000 kg/s、Sb=60 g/kg，穩態S=(MaSa+MbSb)/(Ma+Mb)=37.5 g/kg。
只要鹽度較高，就可忽略溫度並沿用所有上浮羽流公式。
optionsEn: Tenfold seawater-brine dilution means dividing total original salinity by ten.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume ambient inflow Ma=9000 kg/s, Sa=35 g/kg, discharge Mb=1000 kg/s and Sb=60 g/kg.
Higher salinity allows temperature to be ignored and all rising-plume formulas reused.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設外海入流Ma=9000 kg/s、Sa=35 g/kg，排放Mb=1000 kg/s、Sb=60 g/kg，穩態S=(MaSa+MbSb)/(Ma+Mb)=37.5 g/kg。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume ambient inflow Ma=9000 kg/s, Sa=35 g/kg, discharge Mb=1000 kg/s and Sb=60 g/kg. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 海域箱體鹽度收支機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Receiving-basin salinity budget mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「海域箱體鹽度收支」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Receiving-basin salinity budget” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先核對箱體水量與鹽量收支，確認外海交換不是重複計入同一來回潮水。用多深度長時間觀測測試均勻穩態假設，並對交換減弱及初始鹽度做敏感度比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check both water and salt balances, ensuring that offshore exchange does not count the same returning tidal water twice. Test uniform steady conditions against long-duration measurements at several depths, and compare sensitivity to weaker exchange and different initial salinity. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以固定排放分別計算強弱交換情境，畫出完整入出流而非只列超額鹽量。指出箱體平均無法回答哪些底棲問題，並提出可觀察分層的測點配置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate strong and weak exchange cases at fixed discharge, drawing all inflows and outflows rather than only excess salt. Identify benthic questions that a box average cannot answer and propose measurements capable of detecting stratification.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把潮汐往返總流量全當新鮮外海交換會高估沖淡能力，均勻箱體也會掩蓋沿底鹽層；近場校正良好仍不能證明長期區域背景不會改變。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating all back-and-forth tidal flow as fresh offshore exchange overstates flushing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Check both water and salt balances, ensuring that offshore exchange does not count the same returning tidal water twice. Test uniform steady conditions against long-duration measurements at several depths, and compare sensitivity to weaker exchange and different initial salinity.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以固定排放分別計算強弱交換情境，畫出完整入出流而非只列超額鹽量。指出箱體平均無法回答哪些底棲問題，並提出可觀察分層的測點配置。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate strong and weak exchange cases at fixed discharge, drawing all inflows and outflows rather than only excess salt. Identify benthic questions that a box average cannot answer and propose measurements capable of detecting stratification.

quiz.question: 要驗證「海域箱體鹽度收支機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Receiving-basin salinity budget mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
流量乘速度已經是牛頓力，而且所有噴口反力只須加大小。
先核對箱體水量與鹽量收支，確認外海交換不是重複計入同一來回潮水。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Flow times velocity is already force in newtons and port reactions require only scalar addition.
Check both water and salt balances, ensuring that offshore exchange does not count the same returning tidal water twice.
quiz.explanation: 先核對箱體水量與鹽量收支，確認外海交換不是重複計入同一來回潮水。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check both water and salt balances, ensuring that offshore exchange does not count the same returning tidal water twice. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 海域箱體鹽度收支機理與驗證：失效診斷

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
